title: Citizen
tagline: Citizen is a Anonymous Aadhar Verified Crypto Web3 Compliant Wallet
description:
"Citizen" is a pioneering project dedicated to enhancing the accessibility, security, and trustworthiness of the Wallet ecosystem. We recognize that regulatory compliance is a crucial factor in gaining the trust of both users and regulators, and as such, we are on a mission to merge DeFi with robust compliance mechanisms.

Our vision revolves around creating a cutting-edge web3 wallet that seamlessly integrates security, convenience, and regulatory oversight. This wallet is designed to serve as a bridge between traditional financial regulations and the decentralized world of cryptocurrencies and blockchain technology.
how_its_made: We are using Safe Account Abstraction SDK to create a Smart Account which is multi sig wallet, One from the EOA created during the onboarding of the user and the other one which is created from the anon protocol which give JWT token which are valid for sessions and generating a signer through it. So the smart wallet is a multi sig wallet with both of these being the signers
